theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_lbm_vague_cylinder_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (a b : ℝ) (La Lb : ℝ≥0∞), VagueConverges μs μ → a < b → μ (closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) b ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≠ ∞ → Tendsto (fun j ↦ μs j (closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) a ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)))) atTop (𝓝 La) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ μs j (closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) b ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)))) atTop (𝓝 Lb) → Lb ≠ ∞ → μ (closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) a ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≤ Lb ∧ La ≤ μ (closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) b ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)))
